title: Clutch Pedal Position (CPP) Switch
introduction:
This removal and installation procedure applies to the 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT configuration. The pedal-area drawing highlights the switch in blue, its electrical connector in purple and its bracket engagement in the inset.

I use the inset to separate the jobs: the connector joins the wiring to the switch, while the bracket holds the switch in place. Unplugging first keeps the wiring from becoming the switch's leash. The instructions cover removal and refitting; they provide no electrical diagnosis, adjustment or functional-test procedure.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: Before service, disable remote start, if equipped, through the Central Display: Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started at any time, causing personal injury or death. Remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person starting the engine during service; an accidental start can cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Personal protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during vehicle service. Wear protective gloves when handling components with pointed or sharp edges. Ignoring these precautions may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Clutch-system safety review
items.detail: Before starting, review the applicable precautions in [Brake and Clutch Systems Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693183), as required by [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189).

edits.text: NOTE: Read the removal steps before refitting the switch; they may also contain installation details.
edits.why: Details beside a removal operation can also govern how the part goes back.

edits.text: Disconnect the electrical connector from the CPP switch. Locate the switch's retaining tabs at the bracket openings shown in the inset, free the tabs from the bracket and remove the switch.
edits.why: The main view locates the connector below the switch body. The inset exposes the retaining features that are harder to see in the surrounding pedal assembly.

edits.text: Reverse the removal order: seat the switch in its bracket with its retaining tabs engaged, then reconnect the electrical connector.
edits.why: Refitting restores the mechanical mounting before the wiring connection. This completes the supplied installation sequence; it does not establish whether a reported electrical fault has been corrected.
